intro: An HR manager resume that shows the organisation you supported and how hiring, retention and engagement improved under you.
tips: Give the size of the organisation you supported.
Show results in retention, time to hire, engagement scores.
Mention policies and programmes you built.

basics.name: Fatima Al-Sayed
basics.label: Human Resources Manager
basics.summary: HR manager with ten years supporting growing companies in the Gulf. I build the policies, people processes and culture that let a company double in size without losing what made it good.

work.name: Desert Logistics
highlights: Lead a team of five covering recruitment, payroll, employee relations and learning.
Cut first-year attrition from 32% to 18% with a new onboarding programme.
Introduced a performance review cycle and salary bands across all four countries.

work.name: Gulf Hospitality Group
highlights: Partnered with three hotel general managers on hiring and staff relations.
Ran hiring for a hotel opening: 220 staff in four months.
